payload.posture: Read John 21:15–25 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after breakfast Jesus questions Peter three times, commands care for his sheep, speaks of Peter’s death, addresses the beloved disciple, and closes with testimony. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
